name: How much should I expect to pay for trim repair or replacement?

mainEntity.name: How much should I expect to pay for trim repair or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the amount of trim, the material, and whether the job is a repair or full replacement. In Denver, exterior trim repair projects are commonly reported in a broad range from low-cost spot fixes to much larger replacement jobs, so the best way to budget is to get photos reviewed before scheduling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary a lot based on damage size, material, and finish work. Small repairs are much cheaper than full replacement, so photos and measurements help get a realistic estimate.
